youtube.title: Aap Khud Ko Gudgudi Kyun Nahi Kar Sakte? 🤭 #Shorts
youtube.description:
Kabhi socha hai ki doosre ke chhoone par hansi aati hai, lekin apne haath se gudgudi karo to kuch nahi hota? Wajah hai aapka brain, jo pehle se jaanta hai ki aapka haath kya karne wala hai.

Dimaag ka ek hissa chhoone ko pehle hi predict kar leta hai aur us feeling ko kam kar deta hai. Gudgudi ke liye surprise chahiye, aur aap khud ko surprise nahi kar sakte.

The Hidden Why ka Hindi edition: roz ki cheezon ke peeche ki asli wajah.
